# RandTrail

> Practical guides to buying, selling, storing and using crypto, written for South Africa. Covers ZAR funding, exchange choice (Binance and OKX), tax (SARS/CARF) and safety — for South African users.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://randtrail.com/): Overview and entry points to the main guides.
- [Start Here](https://randtrail.com/start-here/): Where to begin with crypto in South Africa.
- [Exchanges](https://randtrail.com/exchanges/): How to choose a crypto exchange in South Africa.
- [Buy & Sell](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/): Buying, selling and moving ZAR in and out of crypto.
- [Wallets & Safety](https://randtrail.com/wallets-safety/): Storing crypto safely and avoiding scams.
- [Tax & Regulation](https://randtrail.com/tax-regulation/): Tax, SARS and the legal status of crypto in South Africa.

## Exchanges
- [Binance South Africa Review](https://randtrail.com/exchanges/binance/): Fees, ZAR deposit routes, safety and who Binance suits.
- [How to Open a Binance Account](https://randtrail.com/exchanges/binance/open-account/): Step-by-step account opening in South Africa.
- [OKX South Africa Review](https://randtrail.com/exchanges/okx/): Fees, ZAR access, safety and who OKX suits.
- [How to Open an OKX Account](https://randtrail.com/exchanges/okx/open-account/): Step-by-step account opening in South Africa.
- [Binance vs OKX](https://randtrail.com/exchanges/binance-vs-okx/): Fees, ZAR access and which exchange to choose.

## Buy & Sell
- [How to Buy USDT with ZAR](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/how-to-buy-usdt-south-africa/): Buying USDT with rands on Binance and OKX.
- [How to Deposit ZAR on Binance](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/how-to-deposit-zar-on-binance/): ZAR deposit methods, steps and fees.
- [How to Withdraw from Binance](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/how-to-withdraw-from-binance/): Cashing out to a South African bank account.
- [Cash Out Crypto at an ATM](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/crypto-to-cash-atm/): Turning BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC into rand cash at Cash Express ATMs via CryptoExpress.
- [P2P Trading](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/p2p/): How peer-to-peer ZAR trades work and how to stay safe.
- [Buy Crypto](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/buy-crypto/): Overview of buying crypto in South Africa.
- [Sell Crypto](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/sell-crypto/): Overview of selling crypto for rand.
- [ZAR Deposits](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/zar-deposits/): Overview of rand deposit options.
- [Withdrawals](https://randtrail.com/buy-sell/withdrawals/): Overview of cashing out to a bank.

## Wallets & Safety
- [Crypto Wallets](https://randtrail.com/wallets-safety/crypto-wallets/): Types of wallets and how to pick one.
- [Account Security](https://randtrail.com/wallets-safety/account-security/): 2FA, passwords and keeping your account safe.
- [Transfers & Networks](https://randtrail.com/wallets-safety/transfers-networks/): Sending crypto on the right network, memos and tags.
- [Scam Prevention](https://randtrail.com/wallets-safety/scam-prevention/): Spotting and reporting crypto scams in South Africa.

## Tax & Regulation
- [Crypto Tax](https://randtrail.com/tax-regulation/crypto-tax/): SARS rules, income vs capital gains and what is taxable.
- [SARS and Crypto](https://randtrail.com/tax-regulation/sars/): How SARS classifies crypto and CARF reporting.
- [Is Binance Legal in South Africa?](https://randtrail.com/tax-regulation/is-binance-legal-south-africa/): FSCA status, licensing and tax.
- [FSCA & CASP](https://randtrail.com/tax-regulation/fsca-casp/): Crypto-asset service provider licensing.
- [FICA](https://randtrail.com/tax-regulation/fica/): Financial Intelligence Centre and crypto.
- [Legal & Compliance](https://randtrail.com/tax-regulation/legal-compliance/): The legal landscape for crypto in South Africa.
